subject: Next steps: rotating demo windows and technical deep dive for Solstice AI
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@solstice.ai>, Michael Chen <mchen@solstice.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: rotating demo windows and technical deep dive for Solstice AI

Hi Suzanne / Michael —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive that works across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders.

Recap (30-min discovery)
- Key use case: Solstice wants to embed Redwood’s hosted inference for synchronous chat and async embeddings into customer support workflows.
- Non-functional priorities: predictable latency <300ms for text gen, tenant isolation for sensitive corp customers, and audit logs for compliance.
- Technical constraints noted: existing VPC peering with GCP in EU region, SSO via Okta, and a desire to test quantized LLM for cost.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Technical deep dive (60–75 min) to walk infra/engineering through sample integration (KV cache, batching, and routing policies).
2) Deliver an initial mutual action plan and a lightweight NDA if legal needs it before sharing customer snapshots.
3) Pilot scope doc attached (MVP-scope.pdf) and a simple availability grid (I’ll follow up).

Scheduling ask
- You mentioned engineers in APAC and EU will want to attend. To keep this repeatable for weekly working sessions, we generally propose 3 rotating windows (one primarily US-friendly, one EU-friendly, one APAC-friendly) and agree on a rotation cadence so no single region carries the burden.
- Can you confirm who needs to attend the first deep dive (names + locations/timezones)? I can propose 4 concrete windows once I have attendees.

Suggested times for a 75-min deep dive (please indicate preference):
- Option A (US-friendly): Tue 2025-08-05 10:00–11:15 PT / 13:00–14:15 ET
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed 2025-08-06 15:00–16:15 CEST
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 2025-08-07 09:00–10:15 SGT

If you prefer a different week we can shift — just want to get a hold of attendees and pick a slot that works for the cross-region team.

Thanks — I’ll attach the availability CSV and a sample invite once we confirm attendees.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0142

Thanks Jonas — good notes.

Attendees for the deep dive (first session):
- Suzanne Park (APAC, SGT) — product lead
- Michael Chen (EU, CEST) — infra lead
- Tom Liu (APAC, SGT) — backend engineer (please add him)
- Priya Rao (US, ET) — CS lead (she may join later depending on time)

Quick preferences:
- We prefer the APAC-friendly slot for the first session because our East Asia engineers will be critical for the PoC kickoff.
- For rotation cadence: monthly rotation would be ideal to keep continuity.

One ask: could you include a short section in the deck that maps our data residency constraints? Our security team will want that up front.

If APAC slot is available, Thu 2025-08-07 09:00 SGT works for Suzanne and Tom. Michael can make a best-effort if we pick a later EU window; he’s partially flexible that week.

Thanks — I’ve looped Tom.

—Suzanne

Morning all —

Thanks for the quick replies, Suzanne. Per Jonas’ note I’ve attached a lightweight availability grid (availability-grid.csv) and a proposed rotation pattern we’ve used successfully:

Rotation pattern (proposal)
- Week 1: APAC-friendly window (Thu 09:00 SGT)
- Week 2: US-friendly window (Tue 10:00 PT)
- Week 3: EU-friendly window (Wed 15:00 CEST)
- Repeat

Rationale: predictable cadence, avoids frequently shifting engineers’ calendars, and makes it easier to record + distribute notes for those who miss a given week.

Jonas — I’ve also added a short security slide on data residency and a checklist we’ll present during the deep dive (attached in the Drive link). If Solstice prefers an NDA before we share internal logs or customer examples we can route that with legal — otherwise the deck has redacted examples.

If everyone confirms Thu 2025-08-07 09:00 SGT we’ll send a calendar invite and mark the session as the APAC kick-off. I’ll draft a 75-min agenda: 10-min intros, 25-min architecture walk, 25-min integration/SDK demo, 15-min Q&A and next steps.

Thanks — attaching the grid and sample invite.

—Ben

Redwood Inference

All — thanks, this looks good. APAC kick-off on Thu 2025-08-07 09:00 SGT works for the team here; we’re comfortable with the proposed monthly rotation cadence.

Two quick items before we close scheduling:
1) Please mark the invite as 75 minutes and include dial-in + Teams link (our EU infra lead prefers Teams).
2) Can you add a short slide on failure modes for the KV cache and typical latency impacts when cold-starting smaller models? That will help our infra team triage during the session.

Ben/Jonas — if you can send the calendar invite and the drive link to the deck I’ll confirm Tom and Michael’s final availability by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

—Michael
